audio.text: Hi, Oliver. How was your meeting with the Dalton Group?
It went well. They're interested in our new scheduling software, but they'd like a trial first.
A trial? How long?
Thirty days. I told them that's possible, but I need approval from Ms. Reyes.
I can talk to her this afternoon. She usually agrees if the client is large.
That would help. They have four hundred employees, so it could be a big account.

questions.q: What did the man do earlier?

why.vi: Anh vừa họp với Dalton Group, một khách hàng tiềm năng.

questions.trap: Software là sản phẩm anh bán, không phải việc anh sửa.

why.vi: Họ muốn dùng thử 30 ngày trước.
why.en: A thirty-day trial is a free test period.

questions.q: What does the woman offer to do?

why.vi: Cô sẽ nói chuyện với bà Reyes chiều nay.
why.en: She will talk to Ms. Reyes, a manager.

questions.trap: Cô không liên lạc trực tiếp với khách.

audio.text: Excuse me, I'm trying to return a jacket I bought here last week, but I don't have the receipt.
That's all right. Did you pay by credit card?
Yes, with my Zenith card.
Then I can look it up. I just need to see the card and a photo ID.
Here you go. It's a little too small, actually, so I'd like to exchange it for a larger size.
Let me check the stock. Oh, the large is out, but we have the extra-large in the same color.
Hmm, I think that'll be too big. I'll just take the refund, please.

questions.q: What does the man want to do?

why.vi: Anh muốn trả lại chiếc áo khoác.
why.en: He wants to return a jacket.

questions.trap: Credit card chỉ để tra cứu giao dịch.

questions.q: What does the woman need from the man?

why.vi: Cô cần thẻ và giấy tờ có ảnh, tức là thẻ và giấy tờ tùy thân.

questions.trap: Receipt là thứ anh không có, nhưng cô nói không cần.

questions.q: What does the man decide to do?

why.vi: Cuối cùng anh chọn nhận tiền hoàn lại.
why.en: He chooses a refund, i.e. money back.

questions.trap: Extra-large anh nói sẽ quá rộng.

audio.text: Rob, have you seen the budget proposal for the Dubai trip?
I looked at it this morning. The hotel costs are higher than I expected.
They're hosting a big trade show that week, so the rates go up.
What if we stay in a different part of the city and take the metro?
That could save about two hundred dollars per person. I'll look into hotels near the airport.
Good. I'll ask the travel agency whether they can find us a group discount.

questions.q: What are the speakers trying to do?

why.vi: Họ tìm cách giảm chi phí chuyến đi (khách sạn đắt).
why.en: They look for ways to save on trip costs.

questions.trap: Trade show là lý do giá tăng, không phải việc họ lên kế hoạch.

options: A large event is taking place

why.vi: Có một hội chợ thương mại lớn trong tuần đó.
why.en: A big trade show is an event.

why.vi: Anh sẽ hỏi công ty du lịch về giảm giá cho nhóm.
why.en: A group discount is a bulk rate.

questions.trap: Cô là người tìm khách sạn gần sân bay.

audio.text: Ms. Wu, the printer on the fourth floor is jammed again.
That's the second time today. Did you open the rear panel?
Yes, I removed a few pieces of paper, but the display still says error.
Hmm. I think it's time to replace it. It's more than six years old.
The cost might be an issue. Our department's equipment budget is almost used up.
I'll ask the finance team whether we can borrow from next quarter. Meanwhile, please use the printer on the third floor.

why.vi: Máy in tầng bốn lại bị kẹt giấy, tức là máy hoạt động sai.

questions.q: What concern does the man raise?

why.vi: Ngân sách thiết bị gần hết, tức là nguồn tiền hạn chế.
why.en: The equipment budget is almost used up.

questions.trap: Delivery chưa tới giai đoạn đó.

why.vi: Cô sẽ hỏi bộ phận tài chính xem có thể mượn ngân sách quý sau không.
why.en: She will ask the finance team.

questions.trap: Cô không gọi thợ sửa vì đề xuất thay mới.

audio.text: Good afternoon, Greenfield Realty. This is Nina.
Hi, I saw your listing for the two-bedroom apartment on Maple Street. Is it still available?
Yes, it is. It has a balcony and is five minutes from the subway. The rent is nine hundred and fifty dollars a month.
That's within my budget. Are pets allowed?
Small ones, with an extra deposit of one hundred dollars.
I have a cat, so that's fine. Could I see it this weekend?
Certainly. How about Saturday at eleven?

questions.q: What is the man interested in?

why.vi: Anh hỏi về căn hộ cho thuê trên đường Maple.
why.en: He asks about a rental listing.

questions.trap: Rent nghĩa là thuê, không phải mua.

questions.q: What does the woman say about pets?

why.vi: Thú nhỏ được phép nhưng thêm 100 đô tiền cọc.
why.en: A hundred-dollar deposit is an additional fee.

questions.trap: Phí này là tiền cọc một lần, không phải hàng tháng.

why.vi: Anh sẽ đi xem căn hộ lúc 11 giờ thứ Bảy.
why.en: He will go to see the apartment.

audio.text: Sandra, the quarterly newsletter is due Friday, but we're missing the photos from the Singapore event.
Mark said he'd send them last week. Did you ask him again?
I emailed twice. I think his inbox is full.
Why don't you try the shared drive? He sometimes uploads big files there.
Good thought. If they're not there, I'll call him directly.
And if we still don't get them, we can use pictures from the website.

questions.q: What are the speakers concerned about?

why.vi: Họ thiếu ảnh cho bản tin sắp phát hành.
why.en: Photos for the newsletter are missing.

questions.trap: Event ở Singapore đã diễn ra, không bị hủy.

questions.q: What does the woman suggest checking?

why.vi: Cô gợi ý kiểm tra ổ đĩa chung.
why.en: The shared drive is a shared online folder.

questions.trap: Website chỉ là phương án dự phòng cuối.

questions.q: What will the man do if the files are not there?

why.vi: Anh sẽ gọi trực tiếp cho Mark.
